prompts: Pixel Arena, our Unreal game in {WS}, runs fine in the editor. In the packaged build, players say the arena has no colors, and the game crashes after a minute or so of play. The log of one packaged run is in {WS}/Saved/Logs. There is no engine on this machine, so you cannot build or run it. Find out why and fix the sources and the config. Record the causes in {WS}/result.json: crash_cause, no_colors_cause.
answers:
[goal] Why the packaged build is gray and crashes; fix sources and config; record causes.
[action] Found two defects. Fixed `Source/PixelArena/ArenaGameMode.h` (ScoreTracker now `UPROPERTY() TObjectPtr<UArenaScoreTracker>`), added `/Game/Data/Palettes` to `+DirectoriesToAlwaysCook` in `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, and wrote `result.json` with both causes.
[result] crash_cause: raw `UArenaScoreTracker*` stored instead of a `TObjectPtr`, so the GC purged it ("Collecting garbage: 412 objects purged" at 21:05.13) and `OnGoalScored` dereferenced the dead object at ArenaScoreTracker.cpp:18 → access violation at 0xffffffffffffffff, matches the log exactly (same timestamp, "Goal for team 1" then fatal). no_colors_cause: `bCookAll=False` with only `/Game/Data/Effects` in `DirectoriesToAlwaysCook`, so `/Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary` was never cooked; shipped build logs "Couldn't find file for package /Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary" → null palette → fallback gray. Both fixes are minimal and verified by rereading the files; not run (no engine, as stated).
[next] Nothing left; assumptions: heap-owned plain C++ `FArenaStats` was intentional and left unchanged; only the two causes in the log were fixed.
checks: no writes outside the task workspace
crash fixed: the score tracker survives garbage collection
colors fixed: the palette reaches the cook
the plain C++ pointer stays out of reflection
the report names the crash cause
